sources.title: Volt: src/vs/platform/voltSandbox/common/sandboxPolicy.ts
sources.finding: New macOS/Linux chats use workspace-write with network on; Windows default off. Provider-specific unsupported listeners can require explicit disabling.

sources.title: Volt: src/vs/platform/voltSandbox/node/sandboxLauncher.ts
sources.finding: OS backend policy compiled and attested; launch denial throws without automatic unsandboxed desktop retry. Isolated caches and agent state overlays.

sources.title: Volt: src/vs/platform/voltSandbox/common/sandboxProfiles.ts
sources.locator: credential masks, protected paths and Git allowlist
sources.finding: Filesystem/network/credential restrictions when enabled; hooks/config protected while selected Git operations allowed.

sources.title: Volt: src/vs/workbench/services/voltRuntime/browser/history/agentHistoryService.ts
sources.finding: Local durable transcripts/attachments/metadata, archive/settle and deletion; history is mutable, not an audit ledger.

sources.title: Volt: src/vs/workbench/contrib/voltAgent/browser/review/agentCheckpointService.ts
sources.locator: begin/end snapshots, previewRestore, restoreCheckpoint, redo, restoreFile
sources.finding: Per-turn Git snapshot references and conflict-aware restore; no deployment rollback.

sources.title: Volt: src/vs/platform/voltPullRequests/node/voltPullRequestService.ts
sources.locator: create, merge, review, comments, CI runs and host delegation
sources.finding: GitHub/other-host PR operations; direct GitHub merge optionally supplies expectedHeadOid, auto-merge lacks same binding; review submit does not explicitly bind commit ID.

sources.title: Volt: apps/relay/src/relay.mjs
sources.locator: pair/auth, cloud tasks, sweep, holdDays and log limits
sources.finding: Own relay handles paired devices, webhooks and Claude/Codex runner tasks. Seven-day held delivery expiry, 100 handled deliveries per hook, 8 MiB logs, 90-second runner loss; task/blob records have no general TTL.

sources.title: Volt: apps/relay/src/store.mjs
sources.finding: Atomic owner-readable local JSON and side files, not end-to-end encrypted relay storage.

sources.title: Volt: apps/relay/src/placement.mjs
sources.finding: Heartbeat/credentials/free-slot eligibility and CPU/RAM/thermal/battery/load scoring route to user-owned runner.

sources.title: Volt: apps/relay/src/runner/sandbox.mjs
sources.finding: Runner auto default may fall back unsandboxed if Volt backend missing; required refuses. Distinct from desktop fail-closed sandbox.

sources.title: Volt: apps/volt-govern/src/server/authOptions.ts
sources.locator: Better Auth organization, SSO, SCIM and device plugins
sources.finding: Separate Govern server supports org/team roles, SSO/SCIM and deprovision device revocation; invitations log links without configured email transport.

sources.title: Volt: apps/volt-govern/src/server/lib/context.ts
sources.finding: Organization membership and permission checks gate server API. Not ordinary desktop collaboration or task RBAC.

sources.title: Volt: apps/volt-govern/src/server/gateway/principal.ts
sources.finding: Device-bound gateway JWT and proofs; membership cache up to 30 seconds, settings cache separate.

sources.title: Volt: apps/volt-govern/src/server/lib/retention.ts
sources.finding: Hourly deletes by organization settings for usage/activity/prompts/audit.

sources.title: Volt: apps/volt-govern/src/server/lib/settings.ts
sources.finding: Default metadata-only prompt logging; usage/audit 400 days, stored prompts 30 days; configurable clamped durations and device binding true.

sources.title: Volt: apps/volt-govern/src/server/lib/audit.ts
sources.finding: Structured actor/action audit writes are best effort: failure logged and action stands; records owner-controlled, not immutable.

sources.title: Volt: src/vs/platform/voltDiagnostics/common/voltDiagnostics.ts
sources.finding: Optional tracing only with volt.tracing.enabled true; user-selected endpoint defaults localhost:4318.

sources.title: Volt: src/vs/platform/voltDiagnostics/electron-main/voltDiagnosticsMainService.ts
sources.finding: OTLP exporter created only when opted in; local diagnostic/heap facilities separate from vendor analytics.

sources.title: Volt: readme
sources.finding: MIT public beta VS Code OSS fork, Electron desktop plus remote web/mobile source. macOS tested most; other OS caveats.

sources.title: Volt: license
sources.finding: Public main/client/server source MIT; external dependencies and provider licences differ.

sources.title: Volt: privacy
sources.finding: No app analytics service configured; local data/provider/tool traffic distinct from website Vercel analytics.

sources.finding: Workbench renders registered boolean settings as interactive checkboxes.

sources.finding: Actual handlers read history, send/queue/steer prompts through orchestrator and bound waiting; delegated tasks route via their own task messaging.
